descFull: Give AI agents eyes and ears. Watch Skill turns video, audio and screen activity into timestamped, searchable evidence, and verifies what a tool actually did with a deterministic contract rather than a model's opinion. DeepWatch brings it into an agent workspace built on the DeepSeek Harness. MCP, CLI, REST and Web.
